completed: MPI-483 CLOSED done/complete, and its headline premise is DISPROVEN. GET /remote/pod/ls sampled every 1.5s through a 14.31GB aria2/R2 install on a throwaway 40GB volume: phantomBytes never left +/-15MB (0.1% of the file). 2.4s in, with 50MB fetched, the .part was already 13.43GB apparent AND 13.43GB of allocated blocks. RunPod network volumes are NOT sparse, so du -sb == du -s --block-size=1 and the shipped flag swap changes nothing measurable. IT MUST NOT BE DESCRIBED AS A 48.65GB FIX anywhere user-facing - that gap is two readings taken minutes apart during a 250-460 MB/s fill (48GB is 2-3 minutes of lag). Bug 2's smoke free-space gate is unaffected and stays.

constraints: ROUTES DO NOT HOT-RELOAD. Any new route needs an app restart before it can be curled, and the app on :3000 is the user's.
THE POD WRAPPER IS UNREACHABLE FROM THE SHELL (curl exit 000). Every wrapper endpoint needs an app route in front of it; /remote/pod/ls is the one that exists.

SAMPLE VOLUME USAGE WITH /remote/pod/ls, NEVER /remote/pod/disk - the latter caches du for 60s and is invalidated only by an install completing or a delete, so every in-flight sample is the pre-install number. It has now produced two confident wrong conclusions.
TO INTERRUPT A DOWNLOAD, STOP THE POD - do not delete it. A delete keeps downloading for seconds. Even a stop finishes anything under ~5GB, so use a >=14GB dep.
AN INTERRUPTED INSTALL STRANDS ITS FULL ALLOCATION on the volume and nothing sweeps it, so a small throwaway volume runs out after two kills (MPI-510).
SEND DEP OBJECTS, NEVER ID STRINGS, to /comfy/models/download/start - the filter reads d.id, so a string set empties and the job completes 0/0 with success:true (MPI-509).
NEVER delete or shrink volume aghcuvg7nl (cubric-smoke, 450GB, EU-RO-1). Always --keep-volume.
H3 TESTS STAY LAST - MPI-508 is live in doing for the turbo LoRA swap.
THE TREE IS SHARED with live peer sessions (MPI-433, MPI-507, MPI-508). Commit by explicit pathspec only. NEVER git checkout -- / restore / stash / reset --hard / clean.
